hints.title: The Cat sprite grows in size when it touches the apple

hints.text:
When the Cat sprite touches the apple, it immediately becomes huge and cannot go through the wall.
To prevent this from happening, use the "wait until __" command and a logical operator. Then one touch with the apple will grow the cat by only 20%, and for the next time, you need to move away from the apple and touch it again.
hints.title: The Cat sprite shouldn't grow immediately

presentation.text:
The Cat sprite isn't allowing the Triceratops sprite to reach the volcano. The dinosaur will only leave if the Cat sprite becomes large enough.
To do that, it needs to touch the magic apple!
presentation.title: Growth apple
